Text.Text: I am Dorn Ketch, the shift foreman. The Maintenance Level below us is mine, and it is full of Mynocks and broken droids. I pay anyone willing to help me clear it.
Here is your patrol rate. The Mynocks will be back, so the same offer stands whenever you want it.
You are back from the Maintenance Level already. Did you kill all ten Mynocks for the patrol?

I do, and the work never runs out. The Mynocks on the Maintenance Level breed faster than I can count them, so I pay by the patrol. Go down the way beside me to the Maintenance Level and kill ten Mynocks. Come back to me here and I will pay you the patrol rate, as often as you like.
Good. Kill ten Mynocks on the Maintenance Level, then come back to me here by the Fabrication Terminals.
You still need to kill ten Mynocks on the Maintenance Level for the patrol rate. Come back to me here when it is done.
Here is your sweep rate. More droids will go wrong, so the same offer stands whenever you want it.
I could hear the banging from up here. Did you destroy all ten Malfunctioning Droids?

I do, on the same standing terms as the Mynocks. The old maintenance droids have gone wrong in the head and they will not take a shutdown code. Go down to the Maintenance Level and destroy ten Malfunctioning Droids. Come back to me here and I will pay you the sweep rate, as often as you like.
Good. Destroy ten Malfunctioning Droids on the Maintenance Level, then come back to me here by the Fabrication Terminals.
You still need to destroy ten Malfunctioning Droids on the Maintenance Level for the sweep rate. Come back to me here when it is done.
They are burned, but the traces are clean. That puts one lift back in service. Here is your pay.
You are back, and I can smell burned circuits. Did you bring me all six sets of Ruined Electronics?

I need electronics. Every Malfunctioning Droid on the Maintenance Level has a control board in it, and even a ruined board has good traces I can reuse. Destroy the droids, collect six sets of Ruined Electronics from them and bring the sets back to me here. With six I can rebuild a lift controller.
Good. Bring me six sets of Ruined Electronics. You can get them from the Malfunctioning Droids on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220.
I still need six sets of Ruined Electronics. You can get them from the Malfunctioning Droids on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
This is good enough to melt down. That makes six patches for six leaks. Here is your pay.
You are back from the supply caches. Did you bring me all six pieces of Ruined Fiberplast?

The coolant lines on the Maintenance Level are leaking in six places. I patch them with Ruined Fiberplast that I melt down, and I have run out. The supply caches around the station have plenty. Search the caches, collect six pieces of Ruined Fiberplast and bring them back to me here.
Good. Bring me six pieces of Ruined Fiberplast. You can get them from the supply caches around the station.
I still need six pieces of Ruined Fiberplast. You can get them from the supply caches around the station. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
That is the first repair shift we have had in a month. Here is your hazard pay, and you earned it. If you want harder work, ask me what is worse than Mynocks down there.
You are back. My repair crew went down an hour ago and nobody has screamed yet. Is the Maintenance Level clear?

It needs a real clean-out. I have a repair crew that refuses to go below this deck until the Maintenance Level is safe. I need you to go down there, kill twelve Mynocks and destroy eight Malfunctioning Droids. Come back to me here when both are done and I will pay you hazard pay.
Good. Kill twelve Mynocks and destroy eight Malfunctioning Droids on the Maintenance Level, then come back to me here. I will tell the crew to get their boots on.
I can't close it, because the refinery depends on that level. If the level closes, the station stops earning money, and then Czerka closes the whole station.
You still need to kill twelve Mynocks and destroy eight Malfunctioning Droids on the Maintenance Level. Come back to me here when both are done.
Good work. It is dead until the labs grow the next one. Here is my top rate, and I am sending the bill to the labs.
You are back, and my crew says the claw marks have stopped appearing. Did you kill the Colicoid Experiment?

There is one thing. The labs grew a Colicoid and lost it, and it is loose on the Maintenance Level right now. My crew found its claw marks on a bulkhead. I need you to go down to the Maintenance Level and kill the Colicoid Experiment. Come back to me here when it is dead and I will pay you my top rate.
Good. Find the Colicoid Experiment on the Maintenance Level and kill it, then come back to me here. It is fast, so do not let it corner you.
I asked the labs that myself, and they told me it was above my grade. All I know is that every time someone kills it, they grow another one and it escapes again.
You still need to kill the Colicoid Experiment on the Maintenance Level. Come back to me here when it is dead.
There is something dangerous loose down there, but I need the level cleared first. Finish the clean-out by killing twelve Mynocks and destroying eight Malfunctioning Droids, then ask me again.
That sounds exactly like Raye. Thank you for making the walk. Here is your pay.
You are back from Supplies. Did Quartermaster Raye take my shift report, and what did he say?

Yes, my shift report. It has to reach Quartermaster Tobin Raye before the parts order closes, and I can't leave my post here. I need you to take the report to Raye in Supplies, on this deck. Then come back to me here and tell me what he said.
Good. Take my shift report to Quartermaster Tobin Raye in Supplies, then come back to me here by the Fabrication Terminals with his answer.
You still need to take my shift report to Quartermaster Tobin Raye in Supplies. Come back to me here once you have his answer.
Good. Please take that back to Quartermaster Raye in Supplies, and say the word bulkhead twice.
Here is my parts order. I need three lift controllers, forty meters of coolant line, and a bulkhead. I mean a whole bulkhead. Tell him I am not joking about the bulkhead.
Goodbye, Foreman. Good luck down there.
What other work do you have for me?
Yes, all ten Mynocks are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
Put me on patrol. I will kill ten Mynocks.
Not today, Foreman. Maybe later.
Do you pay for killing Mynocks?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the Mynock patrol involves.
Yes, all ten droids are scrap.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy ten Malfunctioning Droids.
Maybe another time, Foreman.
Do you pay for clearing out the broken droids?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the droid sweep involves.
Yes, that is all six of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you six sets of Ruined Electronics.
Not right now, Foreman.
Do you need any parts salvaged?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the sets of Ruined Electronics you asked for.
Yes, that is all six of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you six pieces of Ruined Fiberplast.
Not right now, Foreman.
What is wrong with the coolant lines?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the pieces of Ruined Fiberplast you asked for.
Yes, the Mynocks and the droids are all dealt with.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Twelve Mynocks and eight Malfunctioning Droids.
Not right now, Foreman.
Why not just close the Maintenance Level?
What would make the Maintenance Level safe?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the clean-out involves.
Yes, the Colicoid Experiment is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Colicoid Experiment.
Not right now, Foreman.
Why do the labs keep growing it?
Is anything worse than Mynocks down there?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Colicoid.
What job comes after the clean-out?
The parts are logged, but he says claw marks are not a parts problem.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will take your report to Quartermaster Raye.
Not right now, Foreman.
Do you need anything carried somewhere?
Still working on it.
Remind me what to do with your shift report.
Three lift controllers, coolant line and one bulkhead. I will tell him.
Not right now.
Quartermaster Raye sent me to collect your parts order.
